create_imagenet_train_dataset: create an ImageNet dataset instance for training with data_root and split set to train
create_imagenet_val_dataset: create an ImageNet dataset instance for validation with split set to val
create_imagenet_test_dataset: create an ImageNet dataset instance for test split without label annotations
create_imagenet21k_dataset: create an ImageNet21k dataset instance with data_root and optional annotation file for training
review_imagenet_extra_repr: review the ImageNet class extra_repr method to see dataset root directory info
